prerequisites: Completion of the study entry and orientation phase

learning_outcomes.text: Students possess the competence for independent creation of technical drawings and for the constructive implementation of technical tasks according to specifications or functional description through suitable selection and dimensioning of corresponding components and their synthesis into mechanical engineering assemblies and systems.

syllabus_topics: Methodical design and development considering material, load, assembly, operation, costs, ergonomics etc.
Introduction to the calculation of components using examples (e.g., adhesive and welded joints, springs, screws)
